name: Groq MCP
tagline: Ultra-fast LLM inference — 300+ tokens/second on Llama 3, Mixtral, and more.
shortDescription: The official Groq MCP server. Lets your agent run any model in Groq's catalog (Llama 3, Mixtral, Gemma) at extremely high speeds. The fastest LLM API for inference.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Groq MCP server, by Groq Inc. Exposes the Groq API as MCP tools: chat completions, streaming, function calling. Groq runs LLMs on custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware that delivers 300+ tokens/second — about 5x faster than typical GPU inference.

## Why we recommend it

If your agent does a lot of LLM calls (multi-step workflows, code generation, long context), Groq's speed is a real advantage. The latency is so low that complex multi-agent workflows feel real-time. Models include Llama 3.3 70B, Mixtral 8x7B, Gemma 2, and others — all open-source weights, all running on Groq's hardware.

## When to use it

- Latency-sensitive agents: anything user-facing where response time matters
- Multi-step workflows where the cumulative LLM time adds up
- Code generation agents: faster iteration
- Long-context tasks: Groq processes big contexts quickly
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://console.groq.com/keys
2. Set `GROQ_API_KEY=gsk_...`
3. `uvx mcp-server-groq`

**Pricing note:** Groq is significantly cheaper than OpenAI for equivalent models. Free tier is generous.
pricingDetails: Free. Groq: generous free tier. Paid: pay-as-you-go per token, much cheaper than OpenAI.
